testPlan.title: Smooth rebuild and span picks on a loop

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: Load Welker Farms, savegame 3. This ticks by itself.

test.title: Pick on the loop against the traffic
test.hint: Smooth tool, mode rebuild. On the spline loop, click a point, then a point behind it. The span is taken, not refused. PASS if so.

test.title: Move the end on round the loop
test.hint: Click on past the far end, point by point, all the way round to the start. The span keeps growing; the start never jumps. PASS if so.

test.title: Apply the rebuild
test.hint: Right-click to apply. This ticks by itself.

test.title: Only the picked span changed
test.hint: The new points lie where the preview was. The rest of the loop is as it was. PASS if so.
